<script id="ethvelle-v193-palette-settle-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var QUIET=90,MAX=700,MIN_OPEN=170,timer=null,hardTimer=null,mo=null,openingAt=0;
  function dock(){return document.getElementById('ethvellePicsartTextDock');}
  function inComposer(){var c=document.getElementById('ethvelleTextComposer');return !!(c&&c.classList.contains('active'));}
  function end(){
    clearTimeout(timer);clearTimeout(hardTimer);timer=hardTimer=null;openingAt=0;
    if(mo){mo.disconnect();mo=null;}
    var d=dock();if(d){d.classList.remove('ev193-settling');d.classList.remove('ev224-opening');}
  }
  function arm(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    var d=dock(),opening=!!(d&&d.classList.contains('ev224-opening'));
    var remaining=opening&&openingAt?Math.max(0,MIN_OPEN-(Date.now()-openingAt)):0;
    timer=setTimeout(end,Math.max(QUIET,remaining));
  }
  function begin(opening){
    var d=dock();if(!d)return;
    d.classList.add('ev193-settling');
    if(opening){d.classList.add('ev224-opening');openingAt=Date.now();}
    arm();
    if(!mo&&window.MutationObserver){mo=new MutationObserver(arm);mo.observe(d,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true});}
    if(!hardTimer)hardTimer=setTimeout(end,MAX);
  }
  function activeTab(){var t=document.querySelector('#evpaTabs .evpa-tab.active');return t?t.dataset.tab:'';}
  function wantsSettle(tab){
    if(tab!=='font'&&tab!=='color')return false;
    if(inComposer())return false;
    var d=dock();if(!d)return false;
    return d.style.display==='none'||activeTab()!==tab;
  }
  function wrap(name){
    var orig=window[name];if(typeof orig!=='function'||orig.__ev193)return;
    var w=function(tab){
      /* v231: selection-only setTool calls do not start the text-editor loader. */var go=false,opening=false;try{go=wantsSettle(tab)&&(name==='openEthvelleTextStylePanel'||window.__evTextEditorOpen===true);if(go){var dd=dock();opening=!!(dd&&dd.style.display==='none');}}catch(_e){}
      if(go)begin(opening);
      try{return orig.apply(this,arguments);}
      finally{if(go)arm();}
    };
    w.__ev193=true;window[name]=w;
  }
  wrap('openEthvelleTextStylePanel');
  wrap('ethvellePicsartSetTool');
})();

<script id="ethvelle-v199-preload-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__ethvellePreloadV199)return;
  window.__ethvellePreloadV199=true;

  const PLAY_PATH='<path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/>',PAUSE_PATH='<path d="M6 5h4v14H6zM14 5h4v14h-4z"/>';
  const LOOK_MIN=1,LOOK_MAX=3;
  const num=(v,d=0)=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):d;
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const sched=()=>window.__ethvelleAudioSchedulerDiagnostics||null;
  const budget=()=>window.__evDecoderBudget||{pool:3,warm:2};
  if(window.__evRebuffer===undefined)window.__evRebuffer=true;

  const isMedia=ov=>!!ov&&(ov.type==='video'||ov.type==='audio')&&!!ov.src&&!ov.reversePlayback&&num(ov.trimEnd)>num(ov.trimStart);
  const editorActive=()=>{const s=$('screen-editor');return !!s&&s.classList.contains('active');};

  // ---- 1-3s adaptive lookahead: the more cuts coming up, the further ahead we prepare ----
  function lookaheadFor(t){
    let edges=0;
    if(Array.isArray(overlays)){
      for(let i=0;i<overlays.length;i++){
        const ov=overlays[i];if(!isMedia(ov))continue;
        const s=num(ov.trimStart),e=num(ov.trimEnd);
        if(s>t&&s<=t+LOOK_MAX)edges++;
        if(e>t&&e<=t+LOOK_MAX)edges++;
      }
    }
    const w=Math.max(LOOK_MIN,Math.min(LOOK_MAX,LOOK_MIN+edges*.4));
    window.__evPreloadWindowSec=w;
    return w;
  }

  // A split whose second half continues straight on from the first half reuses the same decoder
  // (see transferContinuousSplitVideos), so it needs no separate warm-up.
  function continuesDecoder(prev,next){
    if(!prev||!next||prev.type!=='video'||next.type!=='video'||String(prev.src||'')!==String(next.src||''))return false;
    const ps=Math.max(.05,num(prev.speed,1)),ns=Math.max(.05,num(next.speed,1));
    const srcEnd=num(prev.sourceOffset)+(num(prev.trimEnd)-num(prev.trimStart))*ps;
    return Math.abs(num(prev.trimEnd)-num(next.trimStart))<=.025&&Math.abs(ps-ns)<=.001&&Math.abs(srcEnd-num(next.sourceOffset))<=.06;
  }

  // ---- readiness of everything needed for the next `win` seconds starting at t ----
  function readiness(t,relaxed,activeOnly){
    const win=lookaheadFor(t),t1=t+win;
    const out={win,total:0,done:0,pending:[]};
    if(!Array.isArray(overlays))return out;
    const d=sched();
    const relevant=overlays.filter(ov=>isMedia(ov)&&num(ov.trimEnd)>t&&num(ov.trimStart)<t1);
    // (1) every source in the window must be decoded to PCM, otherwise the cut would be silent
    const seen=new Set();
    if(!activeOnly)relevant.forEach(ov=>{
      const key=String(ov.src);if(seen.has(key))return;seen.add(key);
      out.total++;
      let st=d?d.cache.get(key):null;
      if(!st&&d){try{d.prime();}catch(_e){}st=d.cache.get(key);}
      if(!st||st.status==='loading')out.pending.push('audio');else out.done++;
    });
    // (2) clips active at t need a presentable frame; (3) the next clips need a pre-seeked decoder
    const vids=relevant.filter(ov=>ov.type==='video');
    const active=vids.filter(ov=>num(ov.trimStart)<=t+1e-4&&num(ov.trimEnd)>t);
    active.forEach(ov=>{
      out.total++;
      const el=overlayMediaEls[String(ov.id)];
      const ok=el&&el.tagName==='VIDEO'&&(evOverlayVideoFrameIsPresentable(ov,el,t)||(relaxed&&el.readyState>=2&&!el.seeking));
      if(ok)out.done++;else out.pending.push('frame');
    });
    if(activeOnly)return out;
    const b=budget();
    const slots=Math.max(0,Math.min(b.warm,b.pool-active.length));
    const upcoming=vids.filter(ov=>num(ov.trimStart)>t+1e-4).sort((x,y)=>num(x.trimStart)-num(y.trimStart));
    const need=[];
    for(const ov of upcoming){
      if(need.length>=slots)break;
      if(active.some(a=>continuesDecoder(a,ov))||need.some(a=>continuesDecoder(a,ov)))continue;
      if(overlayMediaEls[String(ov.id)])continue;
      need.push(ov);
    }
    // Warm decoders are best-effort: once we've waited a while, stop holding playback for them.
    if(!relaxed)need.forEach(ov=>{
      out.total++;
      const el=overlayWarmEls[String(ov.id)];
      const target=Math.max(0,num(ov.sourceOffset));
      const ok=el&&(el.dataset.evWarmReady==='1'||(el.readyState>=3&&!el.seeking&&Math.abs(num(el.currentTime)-target)<=.08)||
        (relaxed&&el.readyState>=2&&!el.seeking));
      if(ok)out.done++;else out.pending.push('decoder');
    });
    return out;
  }

  // ---- Decoder kick ----
  // Some browsers leave a paused, not-visible <video> stuck in "seeking" (readyState 1) until it is
  // asked to play once; the player code then waits for readyState before playing -> frozen frame.
  // A short muted play() wakes the decoder; afterwards the element is put back exactly where it was.
  function adopted(el){const m=overlayMediaEls;for(const k in m){if(m[k]===el)return true;}return false;}
  function kick(el,target,keepPlaying){
    if(!el||el.tagName!=='VIDEO'||window.__evNoKick)return false;
    const now=performance.now();
    if(el.__evKicking||now-num(el.__evKickAt)<700)return false;
    el.__evKicking=true;el.__evKickAt=now;
    try{if(window.__evPlaybackDiagnostics)window.__evPlaybackDiagnostics.recordKick();}catch(_e){}
    const done=()=>{
      if(!el.__evKicking)return;el.__evKicking=false;
      try{
        if(adopted(el)&&isPlaying)return;
        el.pause();
        if(Number.isFinite(target)&&Math.abs(num(el.currentTime)-target)>.03)el.currentTime=Math.max(0,target);
      }catch(_e){}
    };
    el.addEventListener('seeked',()=>setTimeout(done,40),{once:true});
    setTimeout(done,1600);
    try{el.muted=true;const p=el.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});}catch(_e){el.__evKicking=false;return false;}
    return true;
  }
  // "stuck" = has been seeking / without data for `ms` continuously (a normal seek finishes far sooner)
  function stuckFor(el,ms){
    if(!el)return false;
    const now=performance.now();
    if(!(el.seeking||el.readyState<2)){el.__evStuckSince=0;return false;}
    if(!el.__evStuckSince)el.__evStuckSince=now;
    return now-el.__evStuckSince>=ms;
  }
  function kickActive(t,keepPlaying){
    if(!Array.isArray(overlays))return;
    for(let i=0;i<overlays.length;i++){
      const ov=overlays[i];
      if(!ov||ov.type!=='video'||ov.reversePlayback||!ov.src)continue;
      if(!(t>=num(ov.trimStart)&&t<num(ov.trimEnd)))continue;
      const el=overlayMediaEls[String(ov.id)];
      if(!el||el.tagName!=='VIDEO'||!stuckFor(el,keepPlaying?350:900))continue;
      let ex=NaN;try{ex=evOverlayVideoExpectedLocalTime(ov,t,el);}catch(_e){}
      kick(el,ex,keepPlaying);
    }
  }
  function kickWarm(sinceMs){
    for(const k in overlayWarmEls){
      const el=overlayWarmEls[k];
      if(!el||el.dataset.evWarmReady==='1'||!stuckFor(el,1200))continue;
      kick(el,num(el.dataset.evWarmTarget,NaN),false);
    }
  }

  // ---- polling wait: resolves 'ready' | 'timeout' | 'cancelled' ----
  function waitReady(opts){
    const cap=opts.cap||5000,relaxAfter=opts.relaxAfter||2000,activeOnly=!!opts.activeOnly,onProgress=opts.onProgress;
    let cancelled=false,lastRender=0;const started=performance.now();
    const promise=new Promise(resolve=>{
      const poll=()=>{
        if(cancelled)return resolve('cancelled');
        const now=performance.now(),elapsed=now-started,t=num(currentAbsoluteTimeSec);
        try{warmUpcomingOverlayVideos(t);}catch(_e){}
        // A paused render creates the <video> element of any clip that is active at the playhead.
        // Only done when one is missing: re-rendering a ready paused clip would re-seek it.
        if(now-lastRender>400&&Array.isArray(overlays)&&overlays.some(ov=>ov&&ov.type==='video'&&!ov.reversePlayback&&ov.src&&t>=num(ov.trimStart)&&t<num(ov.trimEnd)&&!overlayMediaEls[String(ov.id)])){
          lastRender=now;try{renderFrame();}catch(_e){}
        }
        try{kickActive(t,false);}catch(_e){}
        if(!activeOnly){try{kickWarm();}catch(_e){}}
        let r;try{r=readiness(t,elapsed>relaxAfter,activeOnly);}catch(err){r={win:1,total:0,done:0,pending:[]};}
        if(onProgress){try{onProgress(r,elapsed);}catch(_e){}}
        if(!r.pending.length)return resolve('ready');
        if(elapsed>=cap)return resolve('timeout');
        setTimeout(poll,60);
      };
      poll();
    });
    return {promise,cancel(){cancelled=true;}};
  }

  // ---- UI ----
  function setPlayIcon(playing){const i=$('playIcon');if(i)i.innerHTML=playing?PAUSE_PATH:PLAY_PATH;}
  function showPill(text){
    const pill=$('evBufferPill');if(!pill)return;
    const tx=$('evBufferText');if(tx)tx.textContent=text||'Buffering…';
    const stage=$('canvasStage');
    if(stage){const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0){pill.style.left=(r.left+r.width/2)+'px';pill.style.top=(r.top+r.height/2)+'px';}}
    pill.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hidePill(){const p=$('evBufferPill');if(p)p.classList.remove('show');}

  // ---- Play gate (before start and for mid-playback rebuffer) ----
  let pending=null,internalPause=false,playStartedAt=0;
  const stallCount=new Map();
  function cancelPending(restoreIcon){
    if(!pending)return;
    try{pending.cancel();}catch(_e){}
    pending=null;hidePill();
    if(restoreIcon)setPlayIcon(false);
  }
  function runGate(startFn,label,cap,rebuffer,beforeStart){
    const token={};pending=token;
    setPlayIcon(true);showPill(label);
    const w=waitReady({cap,relaxAfter:rebuffer?1400:2600,activeOnly:rebuffer,onProgress:(r)=>{if(pending===token&&r.total&&!rebuffer)showPill(label+' '+Math.min(r.done,r.total)+'/'+r.total);}});
    token.cancel=w.cancel;
    // The media/frame preload and audio startup are separate gates. In particular, a
    // suspended Android WebView AudioContext must finish resume() before the timeline's
    // performance clock starts, otherwise the audio clock begins behind and gets re-anchored.
    Promise.all([w.promise,Promise.resolve(beforeStart).then(v=>v!==false,()=>false)]).then(([res,canStart])=>{
      if(pending!==token)return;
      pending=null;
      if(res==='cancelled'){hidePill();return;}
      if(isPlaying||!editorActive()){hidePill();setPlayIcon(isPlaying);return;}
      if(!canStart){hidePill();setPlayIcon(false);if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('Audio is not ready yet. Please tap Play again.',{icon:toastIcons.info,duration:2200});return;}
      if(!rebuffer)hidePill();
      window.__evPreloadBypass=true;
      let started;
      try{started=startFn();}catch(err){window.__evPreloadBypass=false;hidePill();setPlayIcon(isPlaying);if(window.__evVideoDebug)console.warn('[evPreload] playback start:',err);return;}
      finally{window.__evPreloadBypass=false;}
      if(rebuffer&&started&&typeof started.then==='function'){
        started.then(()=>hidePill(),err=>{hidePill();setPlayIcon(isPlaying);if(window.__evVideoDebug)console.warn('[evRebuffer] resume:',err);});
      }else if(rebuffer)hidePill();
    });
  }

  function activeAudioStartup(t){
    const d=sched();
    if(!d||!d.cache||!Array.isArray(overlays))return {pending:false,promise:Promise.resolve(true)};
    // Populate the native-video ID set before building the startup wait-list. Video sound
    // no longer needs a second network fetch/decode; only standalone audio clips gate on
    // the unified AudioBuffer cache.
    try{d.prime();}catch(_e){}
    const nativeVideoIds=window.__ethvelleNativeLongVideoAudioIds;
    const sources=Array.from(new Set(overlays.filter(ov=>ov&&ov.src&&!ov.reversePlayback&&
      (ov.type==='audio'||(ov.type==='video'&&!(nativeVideoIds instanceof Set&&nativeVideoIds.has(String(ov.id)))))&&
      num(ov.trimStart)<=t&&num(ov.trimEnd)>t).map(ov=>String(ov.src))));
    if(!sources.length)return {pending:false,promise:Promise.resolve(true)};
    const entries=sources.map(src=>{
      let entry=d.cache.get(src);
      if(!entry&&typeof d.load==='function'){try{d.load(src);entry=d.cache.get(src);}catch(_e){}}
      return entry;
    });
    const pending=entries.some(entry=>!entry||entry.status==='loading');
    const promise=Promise.all(entries.map(entry=>entry&&entry.promise?entry.promise:Promise.resolve(entry)))
      .then(()=>true,()=>false);
    return {pending,promise};
  }
  function installStartGate(){
    const prev=window.startPlayback;
    if(typeof prev!=='function'||prev.__evV199Gate)return;
    const wrapped=function(){
      if(window.__evPreloadBypass)return prev.apply(this,arguments);
      if(pending){cancelPending(true);return;}           // second tap while preparing = cancel
      if(isPlaying)return prev.apply(this,arguments);
      stallCount.clear();
      let t=num(currentAbsoluteTimeSec),contextReady=Promise.resolve(true),contextPending=false;
      try{
        const ctx=typeof ensureAudioOverlayContext==='function'?ensureAudioOverlayContext():null;
        if(ctx&&ctx.state!=='running'){
          contextPending=true;
          // Invoke resume synchronously inside the user's Play gesture, then wait for its
          // promise before anchoring playback to performance.now().
          contextReady=Promise.resolve(ctx.resume()).then(()=>ctx.state==='running',()=>false);
        }
      }catch(_e){contextReady=Promise.resolve(false);contextPending=true;}
      try{
        const end=getProjectContentEndSec();
        if(end>0&&t>=end-1/Math.max(1,num(FPS,30))){setCurrentAbsoluteTime(0);t=0;try{renderFrame();}catch(_e){}}
      }catch(_e){}
      let r=null;try{r=readiness(t,false);}catch(_e){}
      const audioStart=activeAudioStartup(t);
      const startReady=Promise.all([contextReady,audioStart.promise]).then(values=>values.every(Boolean),()=>false);
      if(!r||r.pending.length||contextPending||audioStart.pending){
        runGate(()=>window.startPlayback(),'Preparing playback…',10000,false,startReady);
        return;
      }
      // Both decoder and audio are already ready; no artificial delay is introduced.
      return prev.apply(this,arguments);
    };
    wrapped.__evV199Gate=true;
    window.startPlayback=wrapped;try{startPlayback=wrapped;}catch(_e){}
  }
  function installPauseGuards(){
    ['pausePlaybackAtCurrentTime','pausePlayback'].forEach(name=>{
      const prev=window[name];
      if(typeof prev!=='function'||prev.__evV199Guard)return;
      const wrapped=function(){
        if(!internalPause&&pending)cancelPending(true);
        return prev.apply(this,arguments);
      };
      wrapped.__evV199Guard=true;
      window[name]=wrapped;
      try{if(name==='pausePlaybackAtCurrentTime')pausePlaybackAtCurrentTime=wrapped;else pausePlayback=wrapped;}catch(_e){}
    });
  }

  // ---- Rebuffer safety net: only a continuous decoder stall can pause the clock ----
  function checkRebuffer(now){
    if(!window.__evRebuffer||!isPlaying||internalPause||pending||!Array.isArray(overlays))return;
    if(now-playStartedAt<400)return;
    const t=num(currentAbsoluteTimeSec);
    let bad=null;
    for(let i=0;i<overlays.length;i++){
      const ov=overlays[i];
      if(!ov||ov.type!=='video'||ov.reversePlayback||!ov.src)continue;
      const s=num(ov.trimStart),e=num(ov.trimEnd);
      if(!(t>=s&&t<e))continue;
      const el=overlayMediaEls[String(ov.id)];
      // Presentability/alignment can be false during ordinary cut warm-up. Rebuffer only
      // when this actual element has remained seeking or below HAVE_CURRENT_DATA for 600ms.
      if(el&&el.tagName==='VIDEO'&&stuckFor(el,600)){bad=ov;break;}
    }
    if(!bad)return;
    const id=String(bad.id);
    if((stallCount.get(id)||0)>=2)return;
    stallCount.set(id,(stallCount.get(id)||0)+1);
    try{if(window.__evPlaybackDiagnostics)window.__evPlaybackDiagnostics.recordRebuffer();}catch(_e){}
    let suspendTask=Promise.resolve();
    internalPause=true;
    try{
      const d=sched();
      if(d&&typeof d.suspendForRebuffer==='function'){
        suspendTask=d.suspendForRebuffer().catch(err=>{if(window.__evVideoDebug)console.warn('[evRebuffer] suspend:',err);});
      }else{
        const exact=typeof getCurrentAbsoluteTime==='function'?getCurrentAbsoluteTime():Number(currentAbsoluteTimeSec)||0;
        if(playbackRaf!==null){try{cancelAnimationFrame(playbackRaf);}catch(_e){}playbackRaf=null;}
        setCurrentAbsoluteTime(exact);isPlaying=false;playbackStartedAtMs=0;playbackStartTimeSec=exact;
      }
    }finally{internalPause=false;}
    runGate(async()=>{
      await suspendTask;
      const d=sched();
      if(!d||typeof d.resumeAfterRebuffer!=='function')throw new Error('Audio scheduler rebuffer controls unavailable');
      const resumed=await d.resumeAfterRebuffer();
      playStartedAt=performance.now();
      return resumed;
    },'Buffering…',2200,true);
  }
  let lastHousekeep=0,lastKick=0;
  function installTickHook(){
    const prev=window.playbackTick;
    if(typeof prev!=='function'||prev.__evV199Tick)return;
    const wrapped=function(ts){
      const r=prev.apply(this,arguments);
      try{
        const now=performance.now();
        if(!playStartedAt||!isPlaying)playStartedAt=now;
        if(now-lastHousekeep>200){
          lastHousekeep=now;
          lookaheadFor(num(currentAbsoluteTimeSec));
          const d=sched();if(d)d.prime();
        }
        if(isPlaying&&now-playStartedAt>120&&now-lastKick>110){lastKick=now;kickActive(num(currentAbsoluteTimeSec),true);}
        checkRebuffer(now);
      }catch(_e){}
      return r;
    };
    wrapped.__evV199Tick=true;
    window.playbackTick=wrapped;try{playbackTick=wrapped;}catch(_e){}
  }
  // reset the "just started" timer whenever playback (re)starts
  function installStartStamp(){
    const prev=window.startPlayback;
    if(typeof prev!=='function'||prev.__evV199Stamp)return;
    const wrapped=function(){const was=isPlaying;const r=prev.apply(this,arguments);if(!was&&isPlaying)playStartedAt=performance.now();return r;};
    wrapped.__evV199Stamp=true;wrapped.__evV199Gate=prev.__evV199Gate;
    window.startPlayback=wrapped;try{startPlayback=wrapped;}catch(_e){}
  }

  // ---- Project open / refresh: preload the opening window behind a loading card ----
  let openSerial=0;
  function overlayUI(show){const o=$('evPreloadOverlay');if(o)o.classList.toggle('show',!!show);}
  function beginOpenPreload(proj){
    // openEditor() restores the complete overlays array synchronously before this hook runs.
    // Gate only projects that actually contain video/audio media; image-only projects open as before.
    const projectMedia=Array.isArray(overlays)?overlays.filter(ov=>ov&&ov.src&&['video','audio'].includes(ov.type)&&!ov.reversePlayback):[];
    if(!projectMedia.length)return;
    const serial=++openSerial;
    const bar=$('evPreloadBar'),sub=$('evPreloadSub'),title=$('evPreloadTitle'),skip=$('evPreloadSkip');
    if(title)title.textContent='Loading project media…';
    if(sub)sub.textContent='Preparing video and audio';
    if(bar)bar.style.width='4%';
    if(skip)skip.classList.remove('show');
    overlayUI(true);
    let w=null,done=false,audioDone=0,audioTotal=0,audioCapTimer=0;
    const finish=()=>{
      if(done)return;done=true;
      if(audioCapTimer)clearTimeout(audioCapTimer);
      if(serial===openSerial)overlayUI(false);
      if(skip)skip.onclick=null;
      try{w&&w.cancel();}catch(_e){}
    };
    if(skip){skip.onclick=()=>{finish();};setTimeout(()=>{if(!done&&serial===openSerial&&skip)skip.classList.add('show');},2200);}
    // Let openEditor's stage sizing/render complete first, then prime every audio source in
    // the restored project. Split clips sharing one URL are decoded only once by the scheduler.
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(done)return;
      if(serial!==openSerial||currentProject!==proj||!editorActive()){finish();return;}
      let audioJobs=[];
      try{
        const d=sched();
        if(d){
          d.prime();
          const nativeIds=new Set(typeof d.getNativeVideoAudioIds==='function'?d.getNativeVideoAudioIds():[]);
          const srcs=Array.from(new Set((Array.isArray(overlays)?overlays:[])
            .filter(ov=>ov&&ov.src&&['video','audio'].includes(ov.type)&&!ov.reversePlayback&&(ov.type==='audio'||!nativeIds.has(String(ov.id))))
            .map(ov=>String(ov.src||'')).filter(Boolean)));
          audioTotal=srcs.length;
          audioJobs=srcs.map(src=>{
            let task;
            try{task=typeof d.load==='function'?d.load(src):Promise.resolve(null);}catch(_e){task=Promise.resolve(null);}
            return Promise.resolve(task).catch(()=>null).then(()=>{audioDone++;});
          });
        }
      }catch(err){if(window.__evVideoDebug)console.warn('[evPreload] project audio prime:',err);}
      const audioAll=Promise.all(audioJobs).then(()=>true,()=>false);
      // Do not hold project open forever on a broken remote source. The scheduler keeps
      // pending decodes running in the background after this bounded loading-card window.
      const audioLimit=new Promise(resolve=>{audioCapTimer=setTimeout(()=>resolve(false),15000);});
      const audioReady=Promise.race([audioAll,audioLimit]);
      const updateCombined=(r)=>{
        if(serial!==openSerial||done)return;
        const framePct=r&&r.total?Math.round(Math.min(1,r.done/r.total)*40):40;
        const audioPct=audioTotal?Math.round(Math.min(1,audioDone/audioTotal)*60):60;
        if(bar)bar.style.width=Math.max(4,Math.min(99,framePct+audioPct))+'%';
        if(sub){
          const bits=[];
          if(audioTotal)bits.push('Audio '+Math.min(audioDone,audioTotal)+' of '+audioTotal);
          if(r&&r.total)bits.push('Media '+Math.min(r.done,r.total)+' of '+r.total);
          sub.textContent=bits.length?bits.join(' · '):'Preparing playback';
        }
      };
      w=waitReady({cap:10000,relaxAfter:6500,onProgress:updateCombined});
      Promise.all([w.promise,audioReady]).then(([mediaResult,audioResult])=>{
        if(done||serial!==openSerial||currentProject!==proj||!editorActive()){finish();return;}
        if(bar)bar.style.width='100%';
        if(sub)sub.textContent=audioResult?'Project media ready':'Finishing media in background';
        setTimeout(finish,140);
      });
    },200);
  }
  function installOpenHook(){
    const prev=window.openEditor;
    if(typeof prev!=='function'||prev.__evV199Open)return;
    const wrapped=function(proj){
      cancelPending(false);hidePill();
      const r=prev.apply(this,arguments);
      try{beginOpenPreload(proj);}catch(err){overlayUI(false);}
      return r;
    };
    wrapped.__evV199Open=true;
    window.openEditor=wrapped;try{openEditor=wrapped;}catch(_e){}
  }
  // leaving the editor must never leave the card or pill hanging
  const origGoTo=window.goTo;
  if(typeof origGoTo==='function'&&!origGoTo.__evV199){
    const w=function(name){if(name!=='editor'){cancelPending(false);hidePill();openSerial++;overlayUI(false);}return origGoTo.apply(this,arguments);};
    w.__evV199=true;window.goTo=w;try{goTo=w;}catch(_e){}
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&pending){cancelPending(true);}});

  installStartGate();installStartStamp();installPauseGuards();installTickHook();installOpenHook();

  window.__evPreload={readiness,waitReady,lookaheadFor,get pending(){return !!pending;},stallCount};
})();
</script>


<script id="ethvelle-v203-playback-report-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const diag=window.__evPlaybackDiagnostics;
  if(!diag||!diag.enabled)return; // no button, observers or monitor loop without ?evdebug=1
  const STYLE_ID='ev-v203-report-style';
  if(!document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)){
    const style=document.createElement('style');style.id=STYLE_ID;
    style.textContent='#evV203CopyPlaybackReport{position:fixed;right:12px;bottom:14px;z-index:2147483646;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:8px;background:#152b56;color:#fff;padding:9px 12px;font:600 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.28);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}#evV203CopyPlaybackReport:active{transform:translateY(1px)}#evV203CopyPlaybackReport[disabled]{opacity:.7;cursor:default}';
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }
  const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.id='evV203CopyPlaybackReport';button.textContent='Copy playback report';button.setAttribute('aria-label','Copy playback report');
  (document.body||document.documentElement).appendChild(button);

  const stats={gap34:0,gap100:0,maxRafGap:0,longTaskCount:0,longTaskMs:0,maxClockDrift:0,clockOffset:null,lastRaf:null,playingSince:null};
  const safe=(fn,fallback)=>{try{return fn();}catch(_e){return fallback;}};
  const fmt=(v,d=3)=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v).toFixed(d):'n/a';
  const trunc=(v,n)=>String(v==null?'':v).slice(0,n);
  let observer=null;
  if(typeof PerformanceObserver!=='undefined'){
    try{
      observer=new PerformanceObserver(list=>{
        const entries=list.getEntries();
        for(let i=0;i<entries.length;i++){
          const e=entries[i];
          const playing=safe(()=>{const d=window.__ethvelleAudioSchedulerDiagnostics;return !!(d&&d.getPlaybackState().playing);},false);
          if(playing){stats.longTaskCount++;stats.longTaskMs+=Number(e.duration)||0;}
        }
      });
      observer.observe({type:'longtask',buffered:true});
    }catch(_e){observer=null;}
  }
  function playbackState(){
    const d=window.__ethvelleAudioSchedulerDiagnostics;
    return safe(()=>d&&d.getPlaybackState?d.getPlaybackState():{playing:!!(window.__evPlaybackState&&window.__evPlaybackState.playing),time:NaN},{playing:false,time:NaN});
  }
  function monitor(){
    const now=performance.now(),state=playbackState();
    if(state.playing){
      if(stats.lastRaf!==null){
        const gap=now-stats.lastRaf;
        if(gap>34)stats.gap34++;
        if(gap>100)stats.gap100++;
        if(gap>stats.maxRafGap)stats.maxRafGap=gap;
      }
      stats.lastRaf=now;
      const d=window.__ethvelleAudioSchedulerDiagnostics;
      const ctx=safe(()=>d&&d.getContext&&d.getContext(),null);
      if(ctx&&ctx.state==='running'&&Number.isFinite(ctx.currentTime)){
        const offset=ctx.currentTime*1000-now;
        if(stats.clockOffset===null)stats.clockOffset=offset;
        else stats.maxClockDrift=Math.max(stats.maxClockDrift,Math.abs(offset-stats.clockOffset));
      }
    }else{
      stats.lastRaf=null;stats.clockOffset=null;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(monitor);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(monitor);

  function buildReport(){
    const now=performance.now(),elapsed=Math.max(.001,(now-(diag.startedAt||now))/1000);
    const d=window.__ethvelleAudioSchedulerDiagnostics;
    const state=playbackState();
    const ctx=safe(()=>d&&d.getContext&&d.getContext(),null);
    const pool=safe(()=>d&&d.getPoolState?d.getPoolState():null,null)||{};
    const budget=window.__evDecoderBudget||{};
    const stop=diag.stopCounts||{};
    const times=(diag.sourceNodeTimes||[]).filter(t=>now-t<=10000);
    const lastSecond=times.filter(t=>now-t<=1000).length;
    const rateWindowSec=Math.max(1,Math.min(10,times.length?((now-Math.max(now-10000,times[0]))/1000):1));
    const rate10=times.length/rateWindowSec;
    let playbackStatsText='unavailable';
    if(ctx){
      const ps=safe(()=>ctx.playbackStats,null);
      if(ps!==null&&ps!==undefined){
        const get=(...keys)=>{for(const k of keys){const v=safe(()=>ps[k],undefined);if(v!==undefined&&v!==null)return v;}return 'n/a';};
        const count=get('underrunCount','totalUnderrunCount','underruns','underrun_count');
        const duration=get('underrunDuration','totalUnderrunDuration','underrunTime','underrun_time');
        playbackStatsText='underrun count='+count+', duration='+duration+'; raw='+trunc(safe(()=>JSON.stringify(ps),String(ps)),500);
      }
    }
    const videos=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('video'));
    const playingVideos=videos.filter(v=>!v.paused&&!v.ended).length;
    const sourceRows=[];
    const srcs=safe(()=>d&&d.getProjectAudioSources?d.getProjectAudioSources():[],[]);
    const grouped=new Map();
    srcs.forEach(src=>{
      const key=String(src.src||'');
      if(!grouped.has(key))grouped.set(key,{ids:[],types:[],src:key});
      const row=grouped.get(key);row.ids.push(src.id);row.types.push(src.type);
    });
    grouped.forEach(row=>{
      const entry=safe(()=>d&&d.cache&&d.cache.get(row.src),null);
      const status=entry&&entry.status?entry.status:'not requested';
      const error=entry&&entry.error?' — '+trunc(entry.error,140):'';
      sourceRows.push('  clips=['+row.ids.join(',')+'] types='+Array.from(new Set(row.types)).join(',')+' status='+status+error);
    });
    let lines=[];
    lines.push('ETHVELLE PLAYBACK DIAGNOSTICS v203');
    lines.push('Captured: '+new Date().toISOString());
    lines.push('Debug URL flag: evdebug=1; monitoring age: '+fmt(elapsed,1)+' s');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('[Scheduler]');
    lines.push('stopScheduledAll total='+Number(stop.total||0)+'; drift='+Number(stop.drift||0)+', pause='+Number(stop.pause||0)+', start='+Number(stop.start||0)+', edit='+Number(stop.edit||0)+', other='+Number(stop.other||0));
    lines.push('AudioBufferSource nodes: '+lastSecond+' in last 1 s; '+fmt(rate10,2)+' nodes/s over the last '+fmt(rateWindowSec,1)+' s (max 10 s)');
    lines.push('Anchor re-creations: '+Number(diag.anchorRecreations||0));
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('[AudioContext]');
    lines.push('state='+(ctx?ctx.state:'unavailable')+'; baseLatency='+(ctx?fmt(ctx.baseLatency,6)+' s':'n/a')+'; outputLatency='+(ctx?fmt(ctx.outputLatency,6)+' s':'n/a'));
    lines.push('currentTime='+(ctx?fmt(ctx.currentTime,6)+' s':'n/a')+'; max |ctx/performance clock drift|='+fmt(stats.maxClockDrift,3)+' ms');
    lines.push('playbackStats: '+playbackStatsText);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('[Main thread]');
    lines.push('rAF gaps >34 ms: '+stats.gap34+'; >100 ms: '+stats.gap100+'; max gap: '+fmt(stats.maxRafGap,1)+' ms');
    lines.push('PerformanceObserver longtask: '+(observer?'available':'unavailable')+'; count='+stats.longTaskCount+'; total='+fmt(stats.longTaskMs,1)+' ms');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('[Video]');
    lines.push('DOM video elements: '+videos.length+'; currently playing: '+playingVideos);
    lines.push('decoder budget pool='+Number(budget.pool||3)+' / warm='+Number(budget.warm||2)+'; pool state size='+Number(pool.size||0)+' (free='+Number(pool.free||0)+', busy='+Number(pool.busy||0)+')');
    lines.push('rebuffer count='+Number(diag.rebufferCount||0)+'; kick count='+Number(diag.kickCount||0)+'; __evRebuffer='+String(window.__evRebuffer));
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('[Audio decode source status]');
    lines.push(sourceRows.length?sourceRows.join('\n'):'  no video/audio sources found in project');
    return lines.join('\n');
  }
  async function copyReport(){
    const report=buildReport();
    try{
      if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(report);button.textContent='Playback report copied';}
      else throw new Error('Clipboard API unavailable');
    }catch(_e){
      try{
        const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=report;ta.setAttribute('readonly','');ta.style.position='fixed';ta.style.opacity='0';document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();
        const ok=document.execCommand('copy');ta.remove();

      }catch(_err){button.textContent='Copy failed';}
    }
    button.disabled=true;setTimeout(()=>{button.disabled=false;button.textContent='Copy playback report';},1800);
  }
  button.addEventListener('click',copyReport);
})();

<script id="ethvelle-v206-audio-library-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const POP_ID='__ethvelle_pop_3s__';
  const POP_SRC='data:audio/wav;base64,';
  window.__ethvelleV206PopSound=POP_SRC;
  let activeTab='trending',searchQuery='',preview=null,previewSource='',favorites=new Set();
  const favKey='ethvelleAudioFavoritesV206';
  try{favorites=new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(favKey)||'[]').map(String));}catch(_e){}
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const esc=value=>String(value==null?'':value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
  const assets=()=>{try{return (typeof getEditorAssets==='function'?getEditorAssets():[]).filter(a=>a&&editorAssetCategory(a)==='audio'&&String(a.src||'').trim());}catch(_e){return [];}};
  const fmt=value=>{const n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(value)||0));return '00:'+String(n%60).padStart(2,'0');};
  const popItem={id:POP_ID,name:'Pop (3s) Sound Effect',description:'Short pop sound effect for testing',keywords:'pop sound effect trending funny',tags:['trending','sound effect','pop','funny'],category:'audio',duration:3,src:POP_SRC,builtin:true};
  const sfxItems=[
    {id:'__ethvelle_sfx_whoosh__',name:'Whoosh Sweep (2.5s)',description:'Fast airy cinematic swoosh transition',keywords:'whoosh swoosh sweep swish transition sound effect',tags:['sound effect','sfx','whoosh'],category:'audio',duration:2.45,src:'data:audio/wav;base64,',builtin:true},
    {id:'__ethvelle_sfx_metal-rise__',name:'Metallic Rise (3s)',description:'Rising resonant metallic shimmer',keywords:'metallic metal rise shimmer tension sound effect',tags:['sound effect','sfx','metal-rise'],category:'audio',duration:2.85,src:'data:audio/wav;base64,',builtin:true},
    {id:'__ethvelle_sfx_spooky-horror__',name:'Spooky Horror (3s)',description:'Dark eerie drone with a rising tone',keywords:'spooky horror scary creepy dark drone sound effect',tags:['sound effect','sfx','spooky-horror'],category:'audio',duration:3.0,src:'data:audio/wav;base64,',builtin:true},
    {id:'__ethvelle_sfx_flash-zap__',name:'Flash Zap (2.3s)',description:'Bright electric flash and descending zap',keywords:'flash zap electric camera sci-fi spark sound effect',tags:['sound effect','sfx','flash-zap'],category:'audio',duration:2.25,src:'data:audio/wav;base64,',builtin:true},
    {id:'__ethvelle_sfx_cinematic-impact__',name:'Cinematic Impact (2.4s)',description:'Deep cinematic hit with a metallic tail',keywords:'cinematic impact hit boom trailer transition sound effect',tags:['sound effect','sfx','cinematic-impact'],category:'audio',duration:2.35,src:'data:audio/wav;base64,',builtin:true}
  ];
  const searchIcon='<svg class="editor-asset-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"></circle><path d="m16 16 4.2 4.2"></path></svg>';
  const playIcon='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5.5v13l10-6.5z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>';
  const pauseIcon='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14" stroke-width="2.8"/></svg>';
  const bookmarkIcon='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 4.8A1.8 1.8 0 0 1 7.8 3h8.4A1.8 1.8 0 0 1 18 4.8V21l-6-4-6 4z"/></svg>';
  const tabDefs=[['trending','Trending'],['sfx','Sound FX'],['saved','Saved'],['music','Music Clip'],['funny','Funny'],['swooshes','Swooshes'],['asmr','ASMR']];
  function tagsFor(item){return [item.name,item.description,item.keywords,item.tags,item.category,item.type].flat().map(v=>String(v||'')).join(' ').toLowerCase();}
  function matchesTab(item){
    const t=tagsFor(item);
    if(activeTab==='trending')return true;
    if(activeTab==='saved')return favorites.has(String(item.id));
    if(activeTab==='music')return /music|song|bgm|soundtrack|track|melody|instrumental/.test(t);
    if(activeTab==='funny')return /funny|comedy|meme|cartoon|pop|boing|comic/.test(t);
    if(activeTab==='swooshes')return /swoosh|whoosh|swish|transition|sweep|whip/.test(t);
    if(activeTab==='asmr')return /asmr|whisper|tap|click|texture|ambient|soft|close.?up/.test(t);
    if(activeTab==='sfx')return /sound effect|sfx|whoosh|swoosh|metallic|spooky|horror|flash|impact|zap|pop/.test(t);
    return true;
  }
  function currentItems(){
    const list=[popItem].concat(sfxItems,assets());
    const q=searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return list.filter(item=>{
      if(!matchesTab(item))return false;
      if(!q)return true;
      return tagsFor(item).includes(q);
    });
  }
  function stopPreview(){
    if(preview){try{preview.pause();preview.currentTime=0;}catch(_e){};preview=null;previewSource='';}
    document.querySelectorAll('#ethvelleAudioLibraryResults .ethvelle-audio-preview.is-playing').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.classList.remove('is-playing');btn.innerHTML=playIcon;btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Preview sound');
    });
  }
  function previewItem(item,button){
    const src=String(item.src||'');if(!src)return;
    if(preview&&previewSource===src&&!preview.paused){stopPreview();return;}
    stopPreview();
    try{
      preview=new Audio();previewSource=src;preview.preload='auto';preview.volume=1;preview.muted=false;preview.src=src;
      preview.setAttribute('playsinline','');
      if(button){button.classList.add('is-playing');button.innerHTML=pauseIcon;button.setAttribute('aria-label','Pause preview');}
      preview.addEventListener('ended',stopPreview,{once:true});
      preview.addEventListener('error',()=>{stopPreview();if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('Could not preview this audio file',{icon:toastIcons.info,duration:1800});},{once:true});
      try{preview.load();}catch(_e){}
      const p=preview.play();if(p&&typeof p.catch==='function')p.catch(()=>{stopPreview();if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('Audio preview is unavailable. Tap Preview again after interacting with the editor.',{icon:toastIcons.info,duration:2200});});
    }catch(_e){stopPreview();}
  }
  function saveFavorites(){try{localStorage.setItem(favKey,JSON.stringify(Array.from(favorites)));}catch(_e){}}
  function addItem(item){
    if(item.builtin){
      if(typeof currentProject!=='undefined'&&!currentProject){if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('Open a project first',{icon:toastIcons.info});return;}
      if(typeof addMediaOverlay!=='function')return;
      addMediaOverlay({type:'audio',src:item.src||POP_SRC,name:item.name||'Sound Effect',duration:Math.max(.25,Number(item.duration)||3),thumbs:[],peaks:[]});
      if(typeof closePanel==='function')closePanel();
      return;
    }
    if(typeof addAdminAssetToProject==='function')addAdminAssetToProject(item.id);
  }
  function renderResults(){
    const host=$('ethvelleAudioLibraryResults');if(!host)return;
    const rows=currentItems();
    if(!rows.length){
      host.innerHTML=activeTab==='saved'
        ?(searchQuery.trim()
          ?'<div class="ethvelle-audio-empty"><strong>No saved sounds match</strong>Try another search term.</div>'
          :'<div class="ethvelle-audio-empty"><strong>No saved sounds yet</strong>Tap the bookmark on any sound to save it here.</div>')
        :'<div class="ethvelle-audio-empty"><strong>No sounds in this category</strong>Try another category or search term. Admin audio assets will appear here automatically.</div>';
      return;
    }
    host.innerHTML='<div class="ethvelle-audio-library-list">'+rows.map(item=>{
      const id=esc(item.id),name=esc(item.name||'Audio'),duration=fmt(item.duration||item.sourceDuration||3);
      const kind=item.builtin?'Sound effect':'Audio';
      const saved=favorites.has(String(item.id));
      return `<article class="ethvelle-audio-row" data-audio-row="${id}">
        <button type="button" class="ethvelle-audio-preview" data-ev-audio-action="preview" data-ev-audio-id="${id}" aria-label="Preview sound">${playIcon}</button>
        <div class="ethvelle-audio-info"><span class="ethvelle-audio-name" title="${name}">${name}</span><span class="ethvelle-audio-meta">${kind}</span></div>
        <span class="ethvelle-audio-duration">${duration}</span>
        <button type="button" class="ethvelle-audio-action favorite ${saved?'is-saved':''}" data-ev-audio-action="favorite" data-ev-audio-id="${id}" aria-label="${saved?'Remove saved sound':'Save sound'}" title="${saved?'Saved':'Save'}">${bookmarkIcon}</button>
        <button type="button" class="anim-toggle ethvelle-audio-add" role="switch" aria-checked="false" data-ev-audio-action="add" data-ev-audio-id="${id}" aria-label="Add ${name} to timeline" title="Add to timeline"></button>
      </article>`;
    }).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function renderTabs(){
    const host=$('ethvelleAudioTabs');if(!host)return;
    host.innerHTML=tabDefs.map(([id,label])=>`<button type="button" class="ethvelle-audio-tab ${activeTab===id?'active':''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${activeTab===id?'true':'false'}" data-audio-tab="${id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
    host.querySelectorAll('[data-audio-tab]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      activeTab=btn.dataset.audioTab||'trending';renderTabs();renderResults();
      const strip=$('ethvelleAudioTabs');const active=strip&&strip.querySelector('.active');if(active)active.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'});
    }));
  }
  window.filterEthvelleAudioLibrary=function(value){
    searchQuery=String(value||'');
    const wrap=$('ethvelleAudioSearchWrap');if(wrap)wrap.classList.toggle('has-query',!!searchQuery);
    renderResults();
  };
  window.clearEthvelleAudioLibrarySearch=function(){const input=$('ethvelleAudioLibrarySearch');if(input){input.value='';window.filterEthvelleAudioLibrary('');try{input.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(_e){input.focus();}}};
  window.renderEthvelleAudioLibraryResults=renderResults;
  window.renderEthvelleAudioLibrary=function(){
    const body=$('panelBody');if(!body)return;
    body.innerHTML=`
      <div class="editor-asset-toolbar">
        <div class="editor-asset-search-wrap" id="ethvelleAudioSearchWrap">
          ${searchIcon}
          <input class="editor-asset-search" id="ethvelleAudioLibrarySearch" type="search" aria-label="Search audio files" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Search sounds and effects…" oninput="filterEthvelleAudioLibrary(this.value)">
          <button type="button" class="editor-asset-search-clear" id="ethvelleAudioSearchClear" onclick="clearEthvelleAudioLibrarySearch()" aria-label="Clear search">×</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ethvelle-audio-tabs" id="ethvelleAudioTabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Audio categories"></div>
      <div id="ethvelleAudioLibraryResults" class="editor-asset-results"></div>`;
    renderTabs();renderResults();
    const host=$('ethvelleAudioLibraryResults');
    if(host&&!host.dataset.evV206Actions){
      host.dataset.evV206Actions='1';
      host.addEventListener('click',e=>{
        const btn=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('[data-ev-audio-action]'):null;if(!btn)return;
        const id=String(btn.dataset.evAudioId||'');
        const item=id===POP_ID?popItem:(sfxItems.find(a=>String(a.id)===id)||assets().find(a=>String(a.id)===id));if(!item)return;
        const action=btn.dataset.evAudioAction;
        if(action==='preview'){previewItem(item,btn);return;}
        if(action==='favorite'){
          if(favorites.has(id))favorites.delete(id);else favorites.add(id);
          saveFavorites();
          const nowSaved=favorites.has(id);
          btn.classList.toggle('is-saved',nowSaved);
          btn.setAttribute('aria-label',nowSaved?'Remove saved sound':'Save sound');
          btn.setAttribute('title',nowSaved?'Saved':'Save');
          // Inside the Saved filter an un-saved sound leaves the list straight away.
          if(activeTab==='saved')renderResults();
          return;
        }
        if(action==='add'){
          // Same behaviour as the animation switch: it flips on while the sound is added.
          btn.classList.add('on');btn.setAttribute('aria-checked','true');
          stopPreview();addItem(item);
          setTimeout(()=>{if(btn.isConnected){btn.classList.remove('on');btn.setAttribute('aria-checked','false');}},700);
        }
      });
    }
  };
  window.openEthvelleAudioLibrary=function(){
    stopPreview();activeTab='trending';searchQuery='';
    const panel=$('toolPanel'),backdrop=$('panelBackdrop');if(!panel||!backdrop)return;
    const title=$('panelTitle'),body=$('panelBody');if(title)title.textContent='Audio Library';
    if(body){body.innerHTML='';window.renderEthvelleAudioLibrary();}
    panel.classList.add('open');backdrop.classList.add('active');
  };
  // The bottom contextual toolbar should always reveal its first tools when a character
  // animation row/clip is selected, rather than inheriting a stale right-end scroll offset.
  const previousSelect=window.selectClipForChrome;
  if(typeof previousSelect==='function'&&!previousSelect.__evv206ToolbarStart){

      const key=String(which==null?'':which);
      if(key==='main'||/^seg\d+$/.test(key)||/^char\d+$/.test(key)){
        const reset=()=>{
          ['bottomToolsClip','bottomToolsDefault','bottomToolsKeyframe'].forEach(id=>{const row=$(id);if(row)row.scrollLeft=0;});
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(reset));
      }
      return result;
    };
    wrappedSelect.__evv206ToolbarStart=true;window.selectClipForChrome=wrappedSelect;
  }
})();

  const SAFE={

  function fitRect(key,x,y,w,h){
    const S=SAFE[key];if(!S)return {x,y,w,h};

  }
  function svgMarkup(shape){

  };
  window.ethvelleDrawTextBackplate=function(ctx,x,y,w,h,radius,shape){
    if(!ctx||!(w>0)||!(h>0))return false;
    const key=String(shape||'rounded');
    if(key==='square'){ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);return true;}
    if(SAFE[key]){const q=fitRect(key,x,y,w,h);x=q.x;y=q.y;w=q.w;h=q.h;}
    if(key==='rounded'){
      const r=Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(radius)||8,w/2,h/2));
      if(typeof ctx.roundRect==='function'){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);ctx.fill();}
      else{ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();}
      return true;
    }
    const d=pathFor(key);if(!d)return false;
    try{
      if(typeof Path2D==='undefined')return false;
      const path=new Path2D(d);ctx.save();try{ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(w/100,h/100);ctx.fill(path);}finally{ctx.restore();}return true;
    }catch(err){return false;}
  };
  // Public synchronizer used by the live text renderer and older saved text nodes.
  window.ethvelleSyncTextBackplateShape=function(node,t){
    if(!node||!t)return;
    const key=SHAPES.some(x=>x[0]===String(t.textBackgroundShape))?String(t.textBackgroundShape):'rounded';

  #ethvellePicsartTextDock #evpaPalette .evpa-color-wheel{order:-2!important;}

<script id="ethvelle-v219-color-row-order-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  /* Several older layers rebuild the colour row (open, tab change, Transparent tap) and each rebuild
     dropped the eyedropper button and re-created it a frame later, so the row visibly jumped
     (eyedropper / wheel / transparent changed places). This guard runs as a MutationObserver
     microtask, i.e. BEFORE the browser paints, and puts the eyedropper straight back in front of
     the wheel, with transparent right after it. It is idempotent, so it never loops. */
  let proto=null, observed=null, observer=null, busy=false;
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  function inComposer(d){return d.classList.contains('evpa-in-composer')||!!($('ethvelleTextComposer')&&$('ethvelleTextComposer').classList.contains('active'));}
  function fix(){
    if(busy)return;
    const d=$('ethvellePicsartTextDock'),pal=$('evpaPalette');
    if(!d||!pal||inComposer(d))return;
    const live=pal.querySelector('.ev-eyedrop-text');
    if(live){proto=live.cloneNode(true);proto.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');}
    busy=true;
    try{
      pal.querySelectorAll('.evpa-color-wheel').forEach(wheel=>{
        const parent=wheel.parentElement;if(!parent)return;
        let eye=parent.querySelector(':scope > .ev-eyedrop-text');
        if(!eye&&proto)eye=proto.cloneNode(true);
        if(eye&&eye.nextElementSibling!==wheel)parent.insertBefore(eye,wheel);
        const clear=parent.querySelector(':scope > .evpa-transparent');
        if(clear&&wheel.nextElementSibling!==clear)wheel.after(clear);
      });
    }catch(_e){}
    busy=false;
  }
  function attach(){
    const d=$('ethvellePicsartTextDock');
    if(!d||typeof MutationObserver!=='function')return false;
    if(observed===d)return true;
    if(observer)observer.disconnect();
    observer=new MutationObserver(fix);
    observer.observe(d,{childList:true,subtree:true});
    observed=d;fix();return true;
  }
  function boot(){
    if(attach())return;
    const wait=new MutationObserver(()=>{if(attach())wait.disconnect();});
    wait.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  }
  ['openEthvelleTextStylePanel','openEthvelleTextComposer'].forEach(name=>{
    const old=window[name];
    if(typeof old!=='function'||old.__ev219Order)return;
    const wrapped=function(){const r=old.apply(this,arguments);attach();return r;};
    wrapped.__ev219Order=true;window[name]=wrapped;
  });
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();
</script>

<script id="ethvelle-v223-outer-stroke">
/* v227: text stroke is drawn as its OWN layer behind the text, so it only shows OUTSIDE the letters.
   v227 fixes: (1) the stroke layer is now updated IN PLACE instead of being deleted and re-created, and the
   change check no longer uses glyph.style.cssText (other scripts re-write the stroke every frame, which reorders
   cssText, so the layer was rebuilt ~100x per second while playing = the blinking), (2) the layer takes its width and
   height from the exact fractional layout size, so it can no longer wrap onto different lines than the text. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const NEUTRAL='0.001px transparent';
  const CLS='evpa-stroke-clone';
  const S=(el,k,v)=>{if(el.style.getPropertyValue(k)!==String(v)||el.style.getPropertyPriority(k)!=='important')el.style.setProperty(k,v,'important');};
  function parseStroke(v){
    v=String(v||'').trim();if(!v)return null;
    const m=v.match(/^(-?[\d.]+)(?:px)?\s*(.*)$/);if(!m)return null;
    const w=parseFloat(m[1])||0;if(Math.abs(w-0.001)<1e-6)return 'mine';
    let col=m[2]||'transparent',op=1;
    const r=col.match(/^rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*(?:,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)$/i);
    if(r){op=r[4]==null?1:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,parseFloat(r[4])));col='rgb('+r[1]+','+r[2]+','+r[3]+')';}
    else if(/^transparent$/i.test(col)){op=0;}
    return {w:w,color:col,op:op};
  }
  /* v233: 3D stroke. The outline gets a solid extrusion (depth) toward the bottom-right, built from a few hard
     drop-shadow steps that get darker the farther they go, so the letters look like thick 3D cut-outs instead of a flat
     2D outline. The very same step geometry/colours are used by the canvas export (ethvelleDrawStrokeDepth) so the exported
     video matches the preview. */
  function rgbOf(col){
    col=String(col||'').trim();
    let m=col.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*(?:,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)/i);
    if(m)return {r:+m[1],g:+m[2],b:+m[3],a:m[4]==null?1:parseFloat(m[4])};
    m=col.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i);if(m){const h=m[1];return {r:parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),g:parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),b:parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16),a:1};}
    m=col.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/i);if(m){const h=m[1];return {r:parseInt(h[0]+h[0],16),g:parseInt(h[1]+h[1],16),b:parseInt(h[2]+h[2],16),a:1};}
    return null;
  }
  window.ethvelleStrokeExtrude=function(w,unit,col){
    unit=Number(unit)||1;w=Math.max(0,Number(w)||0);
    const depth=Math.max(2*unit,Math.min(14*unit,w*0.7+1.5*unit));
    const n=Math.max(2,Math.min(7,Math.ceil(depth/(1.5*unit))));
    const c=rgbOf(col)||{r:0,g:0,b:0,a:1};
    const steps=[];
    for(let k=1;k<=n;k++){
      const f=0.38+0.34*(k/n);
      steps.push({k:k,x:depth*0.32*k/n,y:depth*0.9*k/n,r:Math.round(c.r*(1-f)),g:Math.round(c.g*(1-f)),b:Math.round(c.b*(1-f)),a:c.a});
    }
    return {depth:depth,n:n,steps:steps};
  };
  window.ethvelleDrawStrokeDepth=function(ctx,line,x,y,maxWidth,w,unit){
    try{
      if(!ctx||!(w>0))return;
      const ex=window.ethvelleStrokeExtrude(w,unit,ctx.strokeStyle);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor='transparent';ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.shadowOffsetX=0;ctx.shadowOffsetY=0;
      ctx.lineWidth=w*2;ctx.lineJoin='round';
      for(let i=ex.steps.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const st=ex.steps[i];
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba('+st.r+','+st.g+','+st.b+','+st.a+')';
        ctx.strokeText(line,x+st.x,y+st.y,maxWidth);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }catch(_e){try{ctx.restore();}catch(__){}}
  };
  function depthFilter(st){
    const ex=window.ethvelleStrokeExtrude(st.w,1,st.color);
    const sx=ex.steps.length?ex.steps[0].x:0,sy=ex.steps.length?ex.steps[0].y:0;
    return ex.steps.map(p=>'drop-shadow('+sx.toFixed(3)+'px '+sy.toFixed(3)+'px 0 rgb('+p.r+','+p.g+','+p.b+'))').join(' ');
  }
  function applyStrokeProps(c,st){
    S(c,'-webkit-text-stroke',(st.w*2)+'px '+st.color);
    S(c,'opacity',String(st.op));
    S(c,'filter',depthFilter(st));
  }
  /* v233: the stroke layer mirrors the glyph's layout props IN PLACE (no clone rebuild) and in the same task as the write
     (microtask), so dragging Letter/Line spacing moves the stroke and the letters together instead of vibrating. */
  const LAYOUT=['fontFamily','fontSize','fontWeight','fontStyle','letterSpacing','lineHeight','textAlign','whiteSpace','textTransform'];
  const kebab=n=>n.replace(/[A-Z]/g,m=>'-'+m.toLowerCase());
  function layout(c,glyph,cs){
    LAYOUT.forEach(n=>S(c,kebab(n),cs[n]));
    S(c,'text-decoration',glyph.style.textDecoration||'none');
    S(c,'transform',glyph.style.transform||'none');
    S(c,'transform-origin',glyph.style.transformOrigin||'center center');
    S(c,'position','absolute');S(c,'left',glyph.offsetLeft+'px');S(c,'top',glyph.offsetTop+'px');
    S(c,'width',cs.width);S(c,'height',cs.height);
  }
  /* v232: stop the stroke "blink" while the Amount slider is dragged. Other scripts write the REAL stroke onto the glyph
     on every slider tick; this layer then had to swap it for NEUTRAL from a MutationObserver, and the observer wrapper
     (v189) delivers late when the frame budget is used up, so one frame was painted with the real stroke on top of the
     fill = flash. Now the write itself is intercepted on the glyph's style object: the real value is only remembered
     (node.__evStroke) and NEUTRAL is what ever reaches the glyph, so the real stroke can never be painted there. */
  const WATCH_KEBAB=new Set(['letter-spacing','line-height','transform','transform-origin','font-size','font-family','font-weight','font-style','text-align','white-space','text-decoration','width','height']);
  const WATCH_CAMEL=['letterSpacing','lineHeight','transform','transformOrigin','fontSize','fontFamily','fontWeight','fontStyle','textAlign','whiteSpace','textDecoration','width','height'];
  function guard(node,glyph){
    if(glyph.__evStrokeGuard)return;
    glyph.__evStrokeGuard=true;
    const st=glyph.style,origSet=st.setProperty.bind(st);
    const owner=()=>{const p=glyph.parentNode;return (p&&p.classList&&p.classList.contains('ethvelle-overlay-text-content'))?p:node;};
    function take(v){
      const str=String(v==null?'':v).trim();if(!str)return false;
      const cur=parseStroke(str);if(!cur)return false;
      if(cur!=='mine'){const n=owner();n.__evStroke=cur;schedule(n);}
      origSet('-webkit-text-stroke',NEUTRAL,'important');return true;
    }
    st.setProperty=function(k,v,p){
      const key=String(k).toLowerCase();
      if(key==='-webkit-text-stroke'&&take(v))return;
      const r=origSet(k,v,p);
      if(WATCH_KEBAB.has(key))schedule(owner());
      return r;
    };
    ['webkitTextStroke','WebkitTextStroke'].forEach(function(name){
      const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(CSSStyleDeclaration.prototype,name);
      if(!d||!d.set||!d.get)return;
      try{Object.defineProperty(st,name,{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:function(){return d.get.call(st);},set:function(v){if(!take(v))d.set.call(st,v);}});}catch(_e){}
    });
    WATCH_CAMEL.forEach(function(name){
      const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(CSSStyleDeclaration.prototype,name);
      if(!d||!d.set||!d.get)return;
      try{Object.defineProperty(st,name,{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:function(){return d.get.call(st);},set:function(v){d.set.call(st,v);schedule(owner());}});}catch(_e){}
    });
  }
  function sync(node){
    if(!node||!node.querySelector)return;
    const glyph=node.querySelector(':scope > .evpa-text-effect-layer');
    if(!glyph)return;
    guard(node,glyph);
    const raw=glyph.style.getPropertyValue('-webkit-text-stroke');
    const cur=parseStroke(raw);
    if(cur&&cur!=='mine')node.__evStroke=cur;           /* others just (re)wrote a stroke: take it as the truth */
    else if(!cur&&!node.__evStroke)node.__evStroke={w:0,color:'transparent',op:0};
    if(raw!==NEUTRAL||glyph.style.getPropertyPriority('-webkit-text-stroke')!=='important'){
      glyph.style.setProperty('-webkit-text-stroke',NEUTRAL,'important');
    }
    const st=node.__evStroke||{w:0,color:'transparent',op:0};
    let old=node.querySelector(':scope > .'+CLS);
    if(!(st.w>0)||st.op<=0){if(old)old.remove();node.__evSig='';return;}
    const cs=getComputedStyle(glyph);
    const sig=glyph.innerHTML;
    if(!old||node.__evSig!==sig){                         /* only the text/bend content needs a rebuild */
      node.__evSig=sig;
      const c=glyph.cloneNode(true);
      c.className=CLS;c.removeAttribute('id');c.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      c.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(e=>e.removeAttribute('id'));
      [c].concat([...c.querySelectorAll('*')]).forEach(e=>{
        S(e,'color','transparent');S(e,'-webkit-text-fill-color','transparent');S(e,'background','none');S(e,'background-image','none');
        S(e,'text-shadow','none');S(e,'box-shadow','none');S(e,'-webkit-text-stroke','0 transparent');S(e,'animation','none');S(e,'transition','none');
      });
      S(c,'max-width','none');S(c,'margin','0');
      S(c,'pointer-events','none');S(c,'user-select','none');S(c,'mix-blend-mode','normal');
      S(c,'paint-order','normal');S(c,'stroke-linejoin','round');
      layout(c,glyph,cs);applyStrokeProps(c,st);
      if(old)old.replaceWith(c);else node.insertBefore(c,glyph);
      return;
    }
    layout(old,glyph,cs);applyStrokeProps(old,st);        /* same text: just follow size/spacing/colour/opacity */
  }
  function syncAll(root){(root||document).querySelectorAll('.ethvelle-overlay-text-content').forEach(sync);}
  let queued=false;
  const pending=new Set();
  function flush(){queued=false;const list=[...pending];pending.clear();list.forEach(sync);}
  function schedule(n){if(!n)return;pending.add(n);if(!queued){queued=true;(window.queueMicrotask||Promise.resolve().then.bind(Promise.resolve()))(flush);}}
  function nodeOf(el){return el&&el.closest?el.closest('.ethvelle-overlay-text-content'):null;}
  function boot(){
    const host=document.getElementById('overlayMediaLayer')||document.body;
    new MutationObserver(ms=>{
      ms.forEach(m=>{
        const t=m.target;if(t&&t.nodeType===1&&t.closest&&t.closest('.'+CLS))return;
        if(m.type==='attributes'||m.type==='characterData'){const n=nodeOf(t.nodeType===1?t:t.parentElement);if(n)schedule(n);}
        else{
          const n=nodeOf(t.nodeType===1?t:t.parentElement);if(n)schedule(n);
          m.addedNodes.forEach(a=>{if(a.nodeType!==1)return;if(a.classList&&a.classList.contains(CLS))return;
            if(a.matches&&a.matches('.ethvelle-overlay-text-content'))schedule(a);
            else if(a.querySelectorAll)a.querySelectorAll('.ethvelle-overlay-text-content').forEach(schedule);});
        }
      });
    }).observe(host,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class'],characterData:true});
    syncAll();
    setInterval(()=>syncAll(),600);   /* font loading / resize change the glyph box without any DOM mutation */
    window.addEventListener('resize',()=>syncAll(),{passive:true});
    window.ethvelleSyncStrokeLayers=()=>syncAll();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();
</script>

<style id="ethvelle-v227-text-quality-css">
/* v227 quality: do NOT pin text to a fixed-resolution GPU layer. will-change:transform / preserve-3d / hidden backface
   made the browser rasterize the text once at its first size and then stretch that bitmap when the text is enlarged
   (blurry text). Without them the text is redrawn sharp at its real on-screen size. */

<script id="ethvelle-v228-fixes-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  /* v228 fix 1 — Transparent colour lock.
     "Transparent" sets the layer's opacity (textOpacity / strokeOpacity / shadowOpacity / textBackgroundOpacity) to 0 and
     leaves it there, so picking any other colour afterwards changed only the (invisible) colour. Picking a colour,
     using the colour wheel or the eyedropper now brings the opacity back (to the value it had before Transparent,
     or the normal default) so the chosen colour is visible straight away. Nothing else about the editors changes. */
  var PAIRS={textColor:'textOpacity',strokeColor:'strokeOpacity',shadowColor:'shadowOpacity',textBackgroundColor:'textBackgroundOpacity'};
  var ALPHA_KEYS={textOpacity:1,strokeOpacity:1,shadowOpacity:1,textBackgroundOpacity:1};
  var DEFAULTS={textOpacity:100,strokeOpacity:100,shadowOpacity:100,textBackgroundOpacity:78};
  var last={};
  function target(){try{return typeof window.ethvellePicsartGetTarget==='function'?window.ethvellePicsartGetTarget():null;}catch(_e){return null;}}
  function slot(t,a){return String(t&&t.id!=null?t.id:'')+'|'+a;}
  function remember(t,a){try{if(t&&Number(t[a])>0)last[slot(t,a)]=Number(t[a]);}catch(_e){}}
  function isZero(t,a){return !!t&&t[a]!=null&&Number(t[a])===0;}
  function restoreValue(t,a){var v=last[slot(t,a)];return v>0?v:DEFAULTS[a];}
  function syncUi(a,val){
    try{
      var dk=document.getElementById('ethvellePicsartTextDock');
      if(dk){dk.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(r){var oi=String(r.getAttribute('oninput')||'');if(oi.indexOf("'"+a+"'")>-1){r.value=val;r.style.setProperty('--ev-range-progress',val+'%');}});}
      var o=document.getElementById('evpa-v-'+a);if(o)o.textContent=val+'%';
      var ps=document.getElementById('evts-'+a);if(ps){ps.value=val;var po=document.getElementById('evts-'+a+'-value');if(po)po.textContent=String(val);}
    }catch(_e){}
    try{if(typeof window.ethvelleRefreshDockSwatches==='function')window.ethvelleRefreshDockSwatches();}catch(_e){}
  }
  function revive(colorKey){
    var a=PAIRS[colorKey];if(!a)return;
    var t=target();if(!t||!isZero(t,a))return;
    var v=restoreValue(t,a);
    window.__evKeepDock=true;
    try{
      if(typeof window.ethvellePicsartSetValue==='function')window.ethvellePicsartSetValue(a,v);
      else{t[a]=v;if(typeof window.renderFrame==='function')window.renderFrame();}
    }catch(err){console.warn('Ethvelle v228 transparent restore:',err);}
    finally{window.__evKeepDock=false;}
    syncUi(a,v);
  }

  function wrapOnce(name,make){
    var fn=window[name];
    if(typeof fn!=='function'||fn.__ev228)return;
    var w=make(fn);w.__ev228=true;window[name]=w;
  }
  function installColorFix(){
    // Remember the visible opacity right before it becomes Transparent.
    wrapOnce('ethvellePicsartSetNone',function(orig){return function(key){try{var a=PAIRS[key];if(a)remember(target(),a);}catch(_e){}return orig.apply(this,arguments);};});
    // Swatch tap / eyedropper / saved colour: restore opacity after the colour is applied.
    wrapOnce('ethvellePicsartSetColor',function(orig){return function(key){var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);try{revive(key);}catch(_e){}return r;};});
    // Older text-style panel path (opened from the composer).
    wrapOnce('ethvelleTextStyleChanged',function(orig){return function(key,value){
      try{if(ALPHA_KEYS[key]&&Number(value)===0){var t0=target();if(t0)remember(t0,key);}}catch(_e){}
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      try{if(PAIRS[key]&&typeof value==='string'&&/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(value))revive(key);}catch(_e){}
      return r;};});
    // Custom colour wheel: when it opens on a Transparent layer, restore opacity the moment a colour is actually chosen.
    wrapOnce('openEthvelleColorPicker',function(orig){return function(key){
      var out=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      try{
        var a=PAIRS[key]||'textOpacity',t=target(),host=document.getElementById('ethvelleColorPicker');
        if(host&&t&&isZero(t,a)&&typeof window.ethvellePicsartSetPickerOpacity==='function'){
          if(host.__ev228Arm){host.removeEventListener('pointerdown',host.__ev228Arm,true);host.removeEventListener('input',host.__ev228Arm,true);}
          var arm=function(e){
            var el=e.target;if(!el||!el.closest)return;
            if(!el.closest('#evpaHueRing,#evpaSatSquare,#evpaPickHex'))return;
            host.removeEventListener('pointerdown',arm,true);host.removeEventListener('input',arm,true);host.__ev228Arm=null;
            var cur=target();if(!cur||!isZero(cur,a))return;
            try{window.ethvellePicsartSetPickerOpacity(restoreValue(cur,a));}catch(_e){}
          };
          host.__ev228Arm=arm;host.addEventListener('pointerdown',arm,true);host.addEventListener('input',arm,true);
        }
      }catch(_e){}
      return out;};});
  }

  function installAll(){try{installColorFix();}catch(e){console.warn(e);}}
  installAll();
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',installAll,{once:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',installAll,{once:true});
  setTimeout(installAll,1500);setTimeout(installAll,5000);
})();
</script>

<script id="ethvelle-v234-scrubber-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__ev234Pill) return; window.__ev234Pill = true;
  var st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = '.ev-clip-dur-pill{position:absolute;top:2px;left:6px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(20,20,22,.72);color:#fff;font:600 9px/12px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2px;white-space:nowrap;will-change:left}'
    + 'body.ev-pill-hide .ev-clip-dur-pill{display:none}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  function fmt(sec){
    sec = Math.max(0, Number(sec)||0);
    if(sec < 60) return sec.toFixed(1)+'s';
    var m = Math.floor(sec/60), s = sec - m*60;
    return m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s.toFixed(1);
  }
  var raf = 0;
  function sync(){
    raf = 0;
    var scroller = document.getElementById('timelineScroll');
    if(!scroller || typeof overlays === 'undefined' || !Array.isArray(overlays)) return;
    var sRect = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
    document.querySelectorAll('.ev-clip-dur-pill').forEach(function(p){
      var host = p.parentElement;
      if(!host || !host.classList.contains('selected')) p.remove();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#timelineInner .overlay-clip.selected[data-overlay-id]').forEach(function(clip){
      var id = clip.getAttribute('data-overlay-id');
      var ov = overlays.find(function(o){ return o && String(o.id) === id; });
      var pill = clip.querySelector(':scope > .ev-clip-dur-pill');
      if(!ov || (ov.type !== 'video' && ov.type !== 'image')){ if(pill) pill.remove(); return; }
      var len = Number(ov.trimEnd) - Number(ov.trimStart);
      if(!(len > 0)) return;
      if(!pill){ pill = document.createElement('div'); pill.className = 'ev-clip-dur-pill'; clip.appendChild(pill); }
      var txt = fmt(len);
      if(pill.textContent !== txt) pill.textContent = txt;
      var cRect = clip.getBoundingClientRect();
      var want = (sRect.left + 6) - cRect.left;              // keep pill at the visible left edge
      var max = Math.max(6, cRect.width - pill.offsetWidth - 6);
      var left = Math.max(6, Math.min(max, want));
      if(pill.style.left !== left+'px') pill.style.left = left+'px';
    });
  }
  function queue(){ if(!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(sync); }
  function boot(){
    var scroller = document.getElementById('timelineScroll');
    var rows = document.getElementById('overlayRows');
    if(!scroller || !rows){ setTimeout(boot, 400); return; }
    scroller.addEventListener('scroll', queue, {passive:true});
    new MutationObserver(queue).observe(rows, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','style','data-overlay-id']});
    // The CapCut recording hides the pill while an edge handle is being dragged.
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      if(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.anim-clip-handle, [data-ov-handle]')) document.body.classList.add('ev-pill-hide');
    }, true);
    var show = function(){ document.body.classList.remove('ev-pill-hide'); queue(); };
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', show, true);
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', show, true);
    queue();
  }
  boot();
})();
</script>

<script id="ethvelle-v239-canonical-keyframe-contact-sync">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__ethvelleV239KeyframeSyncInstalled)return;
  window.__ethvelleV239KeyframeSyncInstalled=true;
  let raf=0;
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  function currentTime(){
    try{
      const t=typeof window.getCurrentAbsoluteTime==='function'?Number(window.getCurrentAbsoluteTime()):Number(window.currentAbsoluteTimeSec);
      return Number.isFinite(t)?t:0;
    }catch(_e){return Number(window.currentAbsoluteTimeSec)||0;}
  }
  function nearest(keys,property,t,tolerance){
    let best=-1,distance=Infinity;
    for(let i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
      const key=keys[i];if(!key||(property&&key.property!==property))continue;
      const d=Math.abs(Number(key.t)-t);
      if(Number.isFinite(d)&&d<=tolerance&&d<distance){best=i;distance=d;}
    }
    return best;
  }
  function paint(track,attribute,index){
    if(!track)return;
    track.querySelectorAll('.kf-marker['+attribute+']').forEach(marker=>{
      const active=Number(marker.getAttribute(attribute))===index&&index>=0;
      marker.classList.toggle('active',active);
      marker.classList.toggle('under-playhead',active);
    });
  }
  function sync(){
    raf=0;
    try{
      const id=String(typeof selectedClip==='undefined'||selectedClip==null?'':selectedClip);
      if(!id)return;
      const t=currentTime();
      const objectClip=typeof window.ethvelleObjectClipById==='function'?window.ethvelleObjectClipById(id):null;
      if(objectClip){
        const prop=typeof window.ethvelleObjectKeyframeProperty==='function'?window.ethvelleObjectKeyframeProperty(objectClip):(objectClip.type==='audio'?'volume':'transform');
        const keys=Array.isArray(objectClip.ethvelleMediaKeyframes)?objectClip.ethvelleMediaKeyframes:[];
        const tol=typeof window.ethvelleObjectKeyframeContactWindow==='function'?Number(window.ethvelleObjectKeyframeContactWindow()):Math.max(.05,9/(typeof pxPerSecond==='function'?pxPerSecond():100));
        const idx=nearest(keys,prop,t,Math.max(.001,tol));
        const prior=window.__ethvelleSelectedObjectKeyframe;
        if(idx>=0)window.__ethvelleSelectedObjectKeyframe={id,index:idx,source:'playhead'};
        else if(prior&&String(prior.id)===id)window.__ethvelleSelectedObjectKeyframe=null;
        const track=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-object-kf-track]')).find(node=>String(node.dataset.objectKfTrack||'')===id)||null;
        paint(track,'data-object-kf-idx',idx);
        if(prior&&String(prior.id)===id&&Number(prior.index)!==idx&&typeof window.syncBottomToolsMode==='function')window.syncBottomToolsMode();
        return;
      }
      let clip=null,track=null;
      if(id==='main'||/^seg\d+$/.test(id)){
        clip=typeof window.getClipByRef==='function'?window.getClipByRef(id):null;
        track=$(id==='main'?'kfTrack':'kfTrack-'+id);
      }else if(/^char\d+$/.test(id)){
        clip=typeof activeClip!=='undefined'?activeClip:null;
        track=$('kfTrack');
      }
      if(!track)return;
      const keys=clip&&Array.isArray(clip.keyframes)?clip.keyframes:[];
      const tol=typeof window.keyframeContactWindow==='function'?Number(window.keyframeContactWindow()):Math.max(.05,9/(typeof pxPerSecond==='function'?pxPerSecond():100));
      const idx=nearest(keys,null,t,Math.max(.001,tol));
      const previous=typeof selectedKfIdx!=='undefined'&&selectedKfIdx!==null?Number(selectedKfIdx):-1;
      if(typeof selectedKfIdx!=='undefined')selectedKfIdx=idx>=0?idx:null;
      paint(track,'data-kf-idx',idx);
      if(previous!==idx&&typeof window.syncBottomToolsMode==='function')window.syncBottomToolsMode();
    }catch(err){console.warn('Ethvelle canonical keyframe sync:',err);}
  }
  function schedule(){if(raf)return;raf=requestAnimationFrame(sync);}
  // The clock setter is called on every accepted scrub frame, after moved clips' keyframe
  // timestamps have already been committed. This schedules one time-based selection pass.
  ['setCurrentAbsoluteTime','seekAbsoluteTimelineSeconds','renderTimelineScrubPreview','movePlayhead'].forEach(name=>{
    const prior=window[name];
    if(typeof prior!=='function'||prior.__evv239KeyframeSync)return;
    const wrapped=function(){const result=prior.apply(this,arguments);schedule();return result;};
    wrapped.__evv239KeyframeSync=true;window[name]=wrapped;
  });
  document.addEventListener('pointerup',schedule,{capture:true,passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('pointercancel',schedule,{capture:true,passive:true});
  const scroller=$('timelineScroll');if(scroller)scroller.addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});
  schedule();
})();
</script>

<script id="ethvelle-v242-media-shapes-and-clip-duration-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const safeText=(s)=>String(s||'').trim().replace(/[\u200e\u200f]/g,'');
  const looksLikeDuration=(value)=>{
    const v=safeText(value).replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g,'');
    return /^(?:\d{1,2}:)?\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?:[.,]\d{1,2})?(?:\s*s)?$|^\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?\s*(?:s|sec|secs|seconds)$/i.test(v);
  };

          const attrValue=attrs.map(a=>{const m=a.match(/attr\((data-[a-z0-9_-]+)\)/i);return m?clip.getAttribute(m[1]):'';}).join(' ');
          if((value&&value!=='none'&&value!=='normal'&&looksLikeDuration(value))||looksLikeDuration(attrValue))
            clip.classList.add(pseudo==='::before'?'evv-hide-clip-duration-before':'evv-hide-clip-duration-after');
        }catch(_e){}
      });
      const cr=clip.getBoundingClientRect();

  }
